title: `SUM` of doubles changes from run to run
verdict: not left to right; order and rounding vary across runs
description: Over LINEITEM's 6M rows, one `SUM` of doubles gave `11475087016.1999` three times and `11475087016.199898` once, in the same query: the order varies with the parallel scan. Over small inputs, ten 0.1 sum to exactly 1 (left to right gives `0.9999999999999999`), yet `1e20 + 1 - 1e20` is 0 in either order: not left to right, not exact.
Over no rows it is NULL; `+inf` and `-inf` sum to NaN; a sum past the range is inf.
reference: `sum` of doubles in any order, within #85's bound. The order is not given, so sverify's SQL refuses double `SUM` and `AVG` on Snowflake (`float_sum`).

provenance.checked_by: sverify_dev.probe_snowflake through the Snowflake CLI (Snowflake characterization session)

evidence.sql: SELECT sum(x), to_varchar(sum(x)) FROM (VALUES (1e20::FLOAT), (1::FLOAT), (-1e20::FLOAT)) AS s(x) UNION ALL SELECT sum(x), to_varchar(sum(x)) FROM (VALUES (1::FLOAT), (1e20::FLOAT), (-1e20::FLOAT)) AS s(x)

provenance.notes: `sverify_dev.probe_snowflake` runs each query through `snow sql` (Snowflake CLI 3.32.1) on an X-Small warehouse, Snowflake 10.40.102, with the session's `TIMEZONE` set to UTC and `USE_CACHED_RESULT` off; every other parameter is the account's default, recorded in the header of probes.json (`WEEK_START` 0, `WEEK_OF_YEAR_POLICY` 0, `DEFAULT_NULL_ORDERING` LAST, `TIMESTAMP_TYPE_MAPPING` TIMESTAMP_NTZ). The inputs are literal `VALUES`, except the `sample-*` probes, which read TPC-H's LINEITEM (6,001,215 rows) in SNOWFLAKE_SAMPLE_DATA.
